title: Science stream (Class 11-12)
summary: Science in Class 11 and 12 keeps the widest set of professional doors open: engineering, medicine, architecture, research, defence and technology.
qualification: 10th pass. Admission to Class 11 Science is usually by your state's or board's admission process.
courses: Science with both Maths and Biology (PCMB)
opportunities: After PCM: engineering, architecture, NDA, B.Sc, computer courses
After PCB: MBBS, BDS, AYUSH, nursing, pharmacy, agriculture, veterinary
next_steps: Choose PCM or PCB (or both) based on whether you enjoy maths and physics or biology.
Check which junior colleges near you are affordable and have good results.
Start building basics for the later entrance exams (JEE, NEET, state CETs) from Class 11.

title: Commerce stream (Class 11-12)
summary: Commerce leads to business, accounting, finance, banking, law, and professional courses such as CA, CS and CMA. It also leaves civil services and many degrees open.
qualification: 10th pass. Maths in Class 11-12 is useful for economics, statistics and some finance courses.
opportunities: After Commerce: B.Com, BBA, CA, CS, CMA, law, banking and finance careers, design and hotel management
next_steps: Decide whether to take Maths or not, based on the courses you want later.
Look at the foundation levels of CA, CS and CMA to see if they interest you.
Check scholarships for Commerce students on this site.

title: Arts / Humanities stream (Class 11-12)
summary: Arts keeps the doors to civil services, law, teaching, journalism, design, psychology and social work wide open. It builds reading, writing and thinking skills that every career values.
courses: History, Political Science, Geography, Economics, Sociology, Languages and more
opportunities: After Arts: BA, law (CLAT), mass communication, design, teaching, hotel management, civil-services preparation
next_steps: Choose subjects you can score in and enjoy reading about.
Start reading newspapers and building writing skills, which help in many entrance exams.
Look at scholarships open to Arts students on this site.

title: Diploma in Engineering (Polytechnic)
summary: A 3-year diploma after 10th that trains you for technical jobs and can lead to a degree through lateral entry. It is a good route if you want to start earning early.
qualification: 10th pass, with Maths and Science for most branches.

entrance_exams.name: State polytechnic admission process (Maharashtra: through the Directorate of Technical Education)

opportunities: Junior technician or supervisor roles in industry
Government junior engineer posts in the right branch (through SSC, state boards, railways)
Lateral entry into the second year of an engineering degree
next_steps: Check polytechnic admission dates for your state after your 10th results.
Compare government and private polytechnics on placement and fees.
Plan for lateral entry if you want a degree later.

title: ITI trades and apprenticeship
summary: Industrial Training Institutes teach job-ready trades such as electrician, fitter, welder, mechanic and computer operator. Apprenticeship gives paid on-the-job training.
qualification: 8th, 10th or 12th pass depending on the trade. Check each trade's rules.

entrance_exams.name: ITI admission through your state's skill development or vocational training department

opportunities: Skilled jobs in factories, construction, railways and the power sector
Self-employment as electrician, mechanic or contractor
next_steps: Find ITIs near you and compare trades and seats.
Register on the Apprenticeship India portal to look for apprenticeships.
Look at lateral or bridge options if you want a diploma later.
